integrity: All seven analytic candidates are attained via support families. The proof establishes equality for every prime-power factor order; finite checker is corroboration, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only products of exactly five finite fields and their weak zero-divisor difference graph clique number; no six-factor or nonreduced extension, no chromatic number, no independent historical-priority certification.
title: Exact clique numbers of five-factor weak zero-divisor difference graphs
